Exercise: One-Arm Kettlebell Row

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_row

Primary Muscles:

- middle back

Secondary Muscles:

- biceps
- lats

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- improve_posture_and_spinal_stability
- develop_upper_body_strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row with Band, equipment: kettlebells, resistance band
- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Row on Bench, equipment: kettlebells, bench

Substitution Options:

- name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Place a kettlebell in front of your feet. Bend your knees slightly and then push your butt out as much as possible as you bend over to get in the starting position. Grab the kettlebell and pull it to your stomach, retracting your shoulder blade and flexing the elbow. Keep your back straight. Lower and repeat.
